newsitem.title: CHINA: China Pacific Insurance profits seen up in 1997.
newsitem.headline: China Pacific Insurance profits seen up in 1997.

text.p: China Pacific Insurance Co expects record profits of 700 million yuan ($84.3 million) in 1997, the People's Daily said on Monday.
The company had reported profits of 600 million yuan in 1996.
China Pacific Insurance expected to rake in 13 billion yuan in premium income in 1997, though it would strive for 14 billion yuan, the newspaper said.
Premium income from its domestic and international business hit 9.82 billion yuan in 1996, 10 percent above it's target.

China Pacific Insurance grabbed 11 percent of China's insurance market in 1995, while the People's Insurance (Group) Co dominated at 79 percent. The sector's premium income totalled 60 billion yuan that year.
